metadata.title: तीखी मिर्ची और फ़ीकी मिर्ची का फर्क | Hottest and the Mildest Chilli | Biggest Chilli Market
metadata.description: Nandurbar is a tribal-dominated district of Maharashtra, also known for its thriving chilli market. This mandi is among the largest in the state and plays a crucial role in the local economy. Shyam Sunder visited the mandi to understand the deep connection between Adivasi communities and this market. Through his visit, he explored the nuances of the chilli trade and examined how Adivasi youth can find entry and opportunities within this business.
